# Example input for tests only (hand-written, not from a real aircraft)
# version
# Betaflight / STM32F405 (S405) 4.5.1
board_name SPEEDYBEEF405V4
feature -AIRMODE
serial 1 64 115200 57600 0 115200
aux 0 0 0 1800 2100 0 0
set serialrx_provider = CRSF
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT300
set dshot_bidir = OFF
set motor_poles = 14
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 250
profile 0
set p_roll = 45
set d_roll = 30
rateprofile 0
set roll_rc_rate = 100
